interpretation: BP-N5, the per-linear sweep: every real projection of both EXL3 fixtures at rows 1, 8, 9, 16, 32, 33, 144, 145, 1,023 and 1,024, native against upstream at the same forced plan and inputs, in EXL3-G and EXL3-O. `cases` maps each case (linear@rows) to its plan, native_plan.py's line without the linears' names (path, then shape and grid, GEMV configuration and grid, or the pinned cuBLASLt algorithms per slice), and the SHA-256 of upstream's final output (F16 or F32 bytes, row-major; both matrices for the fused gate/up). The comparisons are compare.py's summaries per operand placement.
